author: Good Enough
description:
If a shark attacks you, staying calm and reacting correctly could make the difference between escaping and becoming a target.

Sharks are powerful ocean predators equipped with incredible speed, sharp senses, and powerful bites. This video explains what to do during a shark attack, the mistakes that can make the situation more dangerous, and how to improve your chances of surviving the encounter.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most feared predators in the ocean and what experts recommend if you ever come face-to-face with a shark.
title: If a Shark Attacks You, Do This 🦈😲 #animals #wildlife #survival #facts
